workstreams.name: BattleSearchAI series
workstreams.activityWindow: 2026-09-23T18:03Z onward (v3 committed; v4-v8 evolved on train/battle-ai-100pct)
workstreams.goal: Direct strength: heuristic-anchored bounded search with takeover/veto gating, measured by uncapped natural-termination matches.
workstreams.kind: heuristic_anchored_search (no neural network weights; a 'model' here is code + a parameter snapshot)
achieved: v3: Duel 17/20 vs HeuristicAI (P0 10/10, P1 7/10), all natural terminations
Explicit reproducibility handling of the HeuristicAI rng jitter
failed: Large-map P0 first-player is a systematic weakness (v6 0/10)
v4 relaxing the takeover/veto thresholds regressed to 10/20 (noise takeover is harmful)

duplication.v11Side: V11-D01 in v11/out/self_audit.json: an unseeded `new HeuristicAI()` fell back to Math.random, flipping the baseline action between identical runs; fixed by adding fixedRng/seedFromHash.
duplication.battleSide: src/game/ai/battle_search_ai.ts:59-60 already handled exactly this: it passes a derived rng into HeuristicAI with the comment that the heuristic's internal *20/*30 jitter needs a reproducible stream.
duplication.conclusion: Two independent solutions to the same defect. The V11 report does not cite BattleSearchAI.

duplication.v11Side: tools/v11/residual_policy.ts + ranker: learned residual over the heuristic top action, gated by a margin threshold (minDelta 0.02).
duplication.battleSide: BattleSearchAI getAction: heuristic top action by default, overridden only on a large search margin (takeover) or danger (veto).
duplication.conclusion: Same architecture; the difference is the override signal (learned ranker vs bounded maximin search). The battle-side signal is the one that produced measurable strength.

duplication.v11Side: T11-04 required an arm 'baseline-preserving planner without a learning module'. Batch 2 shipped planner/planner_zeroed -- a weaker re-implementation, truncated at 100% by maxDecisionsPerMatch=8.
duplication.battleSide: BattleSearchAI v3 is exactly that arm, already implemented and already measured.
duplication.conclusion: Reusable asset misidentified as a separate project (recorded as F08).

authorityAssignment.for_measurement_and_accounting: V11 pipeline (verified replay, optimized-consumption ledger, transition ledger, controlCheck).
authorityAssignment.for_strength_and_reference_value: BattleSearchAI (bounded maximin search with a heuristic floor).
authorityAssignment.for_dQ_reference_labels: BattleSearchAI evaluateCandidate maximin leaf, labelled PROXY REFERENCE, not optimal Q and not calibrated to win probability.
authorityAssignment.not_interchangeable: BattleSearchAI is not a neural checkpoint: it cannot be registered as a trained model nor shipped in the browser weights path. Its per-decision cost is 1.5-4.5s, versus ~21ms p50 for the spatial network.
